subject.title: Docs option: quick-try link for the autoreview Skill

question: Should ClawHub officially recommend ClawMama as a hosted quick-try provider for the autoreview skill?
rationale: The request changes ClawHub’s official endorsement and trust boundary rather than correcting broken documentation, and current repository guidance does not authorize named hosted providers.

options.title: Keep canonical install paths
options.body: Retain only the official CLI and copyable prompt options and decline this service-specific link.

options.title: Define hosted-provider policy
options.body: Establish neutral eligibility, privacy, disclosure, tracking, and placement rules before adding external trial services.

options.title: Approve ClawMama explicitly
options.body: Add the proposed provider with clear third-party and privacy disclosure and intentional acceptance of the endorsement boundary.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical install paths
recommendation.body: Retain only the official CLI and copyable prompt options and decline this service-specific link.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the repository’s applicable third-party catalog endorsement policy, making him the strongest available owner for this trust-boundary decision.
